statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
There is concern for a potential transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias
The procedure was performed to identify an intermittent arrhythmia as the cause of these symptoms
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
